messages.subject: RE: WITHOUT PREJUDICE - Hale settlement agreement (mark-up)
messages.plaintextBody:
Dear Mr Gallagher,

Our mark-up is attached. Mr Hale's position is that the ex gratia figure should be £125,000 given the strength of the discrimination claim and his age. We've also increased the legal fee contribution to £1,500 plus VAT and added an outplacement clause at 2.6. Other terms are largely agreed subject to those points.

messages.subject: FW: WITHOUT PREJUDICE - Hale settlement agreement (mark-up)
messages.plaintextBody:
Sarah - Ashworth Quinn have come back at £125k plus a £1,500 fee contribution and outplacement. I think we land at £115k, accept outplacement but cap the fee contribution at £750. That's within Edward's authority. I'll prepare our counter-redline.

Kind regards,
Tom Gallagher
Associate

Whitfield Carter LLP
22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ
T +44 (0)20 7946 0000
Confidential and may be legally privileged.
